I went here a few weeks ago and had the most lovely experience. Cathy was super helpful and kind, and had the best recommendations! 10/10 my absolute favorite dispensary I've ever gone to and will definitely be back. Thank you Cathy - you are truly the best!

Dude who goes by donut is awesome, funny as too, 10/10 service. Will continue buying here 💯💯

events.title: Highway 90 Dispensary’s 1 Year Anniversary
events.html:
We’re thrilled to celebrate our 1st anniversary at Highway 90 Dispensary all weekend long from January 16th-20th! It’s been an incredible year, and we couldn’t have made it this far without the love and support of our loyal customers and amazing community. To show our gratitude, we’re throwing a celebration you won’t want to miss!

Celebrate with Store-Wide Deals, Giveaways & More!
From January 16th-20th, enjoy store-wide deals, exciting giveaways, brand pop-ups, and so much more! As a special thank you, we’re giving you the chance to win big:

  • One lucky winner will receive a $200 Ticketmaster gift card and a $100 Highway 90 gift card! To enter, simply make a $50+ purchase during the weekend of January 16th-20th to be automatically entered! 

Want an Extra Entry? It’s easy! For an extra entry, just follow us on Instagram , like our 1 Year Anniversary post, and tag a friend in the comments! Unlimited entries allowed!

Exclusive Discounts for Our Loyal Customers!
We’ve got something extra special for those of you who’ve supported us since day one! Stay tuned for exclusive discounts to be announced soon.

Goodie Bags & Freebies!
The first 30 customers on Monday, January 20th will get a fantastic goodie bag filled with Weis Day Spa gift cards, freebies, and more surprises. Purchase required for goodie bags, available while supplies last.

Extra Perks When You Shop
Spend $100 or more and get a FREE $25 Highway 90 gift card! *Conditions apply

Don’t Miss Our Brand Pop-Ups!
We’ve got some exciting brand pop-ups lined up:

  • January 16th: Wei’s Day Spa Massages from 2-6pm*
  • January 16th: Wana from 5-7pm
  • January 17th: Garden Greens from 12-2pm
  • January 17th: Edie Parker from 4-6pm
  • January 18th: Clade 9 from 12-2pm

Come meet the brands, discover their amazing products, and join in the fun!

*Conditions apply; must make a purchase for massage, time limit applied.

Extra Specials for VIP members

Stay tuned for more surprises exclusive to our VIP members! Not a VIP? Sign up now in the Highway 90 app for $12/month or $100/year. Perks include:

  • 100 bonus points every month
  • One 25% off coupon every month
  • One 10% off coupon every month
  • 1.5 loyalty points for every dollar spent

Get Your Free Tickets!
Don’t miss out! Visit our Eventbrite page to claim your free tickets and let us know you’ll be there. Exciting surprises and announcements are on the way! Join our loyalty program to stay updated on exclusive deals, details, and more. Download the Highway 90 App today and sign up for loyalty! As a bonus, you’ll earn 100 loyalty points just for downloading the app. Available now on the Apple App Store and Google Play.

We can’t wait to celebrate this milestone with all of our supportive and loyal customers. Thank you for an unforgettable year—here’s to many more! 🎉
